title: Design CI publishing for generated host artifacts
description: Verify and implement a GitHub Actions publishing flow for generated Codex, Claude, and Gemini host packages. Strategy to evaluate: keep generated host outputs gitignored in main, build them in CI with python3 scripts/package.py build --target all, validate with package checks and host validators, then publish installable artifacts via the right channel: release assets, a generated publishing branch, or marketplace-compatible repo layout. Confirm Claude marketplace expectations, Gemini extension install behavior, and Codex plugin install behavior before implementation.
close_reason: GitHub Actions workflow added for generated host package artifacts and release assets.
